_comment: Research candidate #3: Devstral Small 2 24B (Mistral, 2025-12, Apache-2.0) — 24B dense ministral3 (40 layers, 8 KV heads -> KV 5.4 GB @131k q4_0). UD-Q4_K_XL 14.51 GB weights -> ~22.1 GB total, 9.9 GB headroom; YaRN to 393216 (card 256k). SWE-bench Verified 68.0 — best 24B-class agentic score; dense, so slower per token than the ~3B-active MoEs. Drop-in successor to mistral-small-3.2-24b. Stock llama.cpp needs the mistral3 attn-factor fix (PR #17945, merged 2025-12-12).
